visualCharacteristics.structure: icon + heading + text | form fields + consent

contentPattern: Row 1, 2 cells: intro cell = icon paragraph (:email: or image), h2, paragraph | form cell = bulleted list of fields (each item: label text, with a nested list: 1st item = validation message, 2nd item = clear-button aria label), a paragraph with the submit link (bold link; link text = button label, href = POST endpoint), consent paragraph(s) with links. Optional row 2, 1 cell: success message (icon, h3, paragraph) shown only when the endpoint answers resp.ok. Same field-list convention as the footer sign-up. Submits POST JSON {data: {<field_name>: value}}; field names are the label slugified (First name -> first_name, Email -> email). A label containing 'mail' makes an email field; all fields are required.
